questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
I reccomend berkeley student coops, they have a website called
bsc.coop
. They have different houses with different "themes" or identities. Be aware that casa zimbabwe is the party coop

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: the coops are often pretty nasty but also by far the cheapest option.

How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: you registered online. you can be on the waitlist for courses too. If youre 1-10 you are very likely to get in.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: you can email the BIO office

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Pretty successful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: You have to register classes in the moment the portal opens, if you wanna have a good chance of getting the classes you want. You can be on waitlist for classes too, and if youre from 1-10 on the waitlist, you'll most likely get in. I recommend classes by the professor Laleh and by Holly Scrouth
